adjudication.rationale: In `store.js.es6` `_hydrateEmbedded`, the new plural branch does `const hydrated = obj[k].map(...)` and then assigns `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = hydrated || []`. Since `.map` returns an array when called successfully, the `|| []` fallback is effectively redundant. Also, the plural branch unconditionally `delete obj[k]`, while the singular branch only deletes the original `*_id` key when a hydrated object is found (`if (hydrated) { ... delete obj[k]; }`). That’s a concrete inconsistency introduced by the diff and could matter in edge cases where a referenced id can’t be looked up (plural would drop the ids, singular would keep them), but the diff alone doesn’t prove it causes a runtime failure in current usage.
